commands.name: list-leagues
commands.summary: List all available leagues across all sports and seasons, with shortcut and season ids for the other commands

commands.name: list-leagues-by-season
commands.summary: List leagues for one season from the website's league overview (name, created info, results/schedule links that contain the league shortcut)

commands.name: list-sports
commands.summary: List all sports available in OpenLigaDB

commands.name: list-teams
commands.summary: List the teams of a league in a season, with the teamId values used by match commands

commands.name: list-matchdays
commands.summary: List the matchdays (groups) of a league season, with groupOrderID used as the matchday number

commands.name: get-current-matchday
commands.summary: Get the current matchday (group) of a league

commands.name: list-matchday-matches
commands.summary: List all matches (fixtures and results) of one matchday in a league season

commands.name: search-team-matches
commands.summary: List a league season's matches for teams whose name contains the given text

commands.name: get-match
commands.summary: Get full details of one match by matchID: teams, results, goals, location and viewers

commands.name: get-head-to-head
commands.summary: List all recorded matches between two teams, identified by teamId

commands.name: list-team-matches
commands.summary: List a team's matches in a time window around today, given as weeks in the past and weeks in the future

commands.name: get-next-match
commands.summary: Get the next upcoming match of a league

commands.name: get-last-match
commands.summary: Get the most recently played match of a league

commands.name: get-standings
commands.summary: Get the league table (standings) for a league season

commands.name: get-top-scorers
commands.summary: Get the goal scorers ranking for a league season

commands.name: get-last-change
commands.summary: Get the timestamp of the last data change for one matchday; a cheap poll before refetching match data
